title: Residents Affected by Chemical Odours from Factories in Pioneer Constituency
what_it_is: Residents Affected by Chemical Odours from Factories in Pioneer Constituency

sections.label: NEA monitors western region air
sections.summary: NEA monitors ambient VOC and pollutant levels in the western region, which were within safe levels and normal air quality bands.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA continuously monitors the ambient air levels of key pollutants as well as Volatile Organic Compounds or VOCs, which are organic vapours of common industrial emissions and precursors of ozone.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The ambient VOC levels in the western region are in the parts per billion and parts per trillion range, well within safe levels which are mostly in the parts per million range.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The ambient air quality in the western region was also in the normal range from January to September 2020, with the Pollutant Standards Index ranging from 14 to 66 in the Good to Moderate bands.

sections.label: Regulated industrial pollutant emissions
sections.summary: Emissions of key industrial pollutants such as sulphur dioxide, oxides of nitrogen, carbon monoxide, dioxins and furans are regulated under the Environmental Protection and Management Act.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Emissions of key industrial pollutants such as sulphur dioxide, oxides of nitrogen, carbon monoxide, dioxins and furans are regulated under the Environmental Protection and Management Act.

sections.label: Jurong factory inspections yearly
sections.summary: About 150 inspections are conducted every year at factories in the Jurong area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: About 150 inspections are conducted every year at factories in the Jurong area.

sections.label: NEA advises odour mitigation measures
sections.summary: NEA has advised factories on additional mitigation measures such as odour control systems and dispersion fans to reduce odours from their premises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA has advised these factories on additional mitigation measures, such as the installation of odour control systems and dispersion fans to reduce odours from their premises.

sections.label: Government accepts three suggestions
sections.summary: The speaker says some things are not within their control, but the three suggestions will be taken on board.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Some of these things are not within our control.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But, with regards to the three suggestions, I would say yes, we will take all this on board.

sections.label: Factory audits and checks
sections.summary: Regular checks are done for factories, with high-risk and large emitters submitting accredited annual reports and checked twice a year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regards to audits of the factories, we do regular checks for factories.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, for the higher risk factories and particularly for the large emitters, we need them to submit accredited reports on an annual basis and we actually check these high-risk factories twice a year.
